paras: After Chapter 8 you'll know which AI setting to use and when. Use fast and cheap for a quick question, so you stop burning your usage on overkill. Use the slower setting for serious work, so a missed fact doesn't cost you later. It's one piece of a bigger method.
AI answers come back bland for one reason: a thin request gets a thin answer.
One habit to use today. Before AI writes anything, tell it: "Ask me the five questions that would most improve the quality of your draft."
The full method is in The Artificial Advantage. The bundle has the book, the Toolkit and three exclusive bonuses.
